title: Spyglass: Now Generally Available!
summary: We're thrilled to announce the official launch of Spyglass, making our powerful new tool available to everyone.

title: Complete File Management for Your Content
summary: We've delivered a powerful new suite of tools that gives you unparalleled control over how you manage and display all your images and documents directly within the editor.

title: Introducing Our Public Roadmap
summary: Discover our new public roadmap, offering a clear and exciting look into features we've shipped, what's coming soon, and our vision for the future.

title: Enhanced Checkbox Experience
summary: Enjoy a more intuitive and visually appealing editor with our newly enhanced checkboxes, now bigger, easier to click, and fully draggable for improved task management.

title: Enhanced Real-time Collaboration
summary: We've significantly improved the real-time collaboration experience, making it easier and more intuitive for teams to work together and stay perfectly in sync.

title: Find and Collaborate on Shared Items with Ease
summary: Effortlessly discover and work together on shared ideas and quests, now with enhanced visibility in your search results.

title: Global Language Support
summary: We're thrilled to introduce comprehensive support for international languages, making Noeko accessible and enjoyable for users around the world.

title: Noeko is now Open Source
summary: Noeko is now fully open source, empowering our community with complete control, direct involvement, and unparalleled transparency.

title: Empowered Constellation View
summary: Unlock deeper insights and streamline your workflow by exploring your knowledge base with powerful new filtering capabilities and personalized views.

title: Precision Search with Saved Collections
summary: Gain unparalleled control over your knowledge by applying comprehensive filters, customizing sort orders, and saving your perfectly refined searches for future reference.

title: Interactive Linked Notes Display
summary: Discover a smarter way to visualize and engage with your interconnected notes, making it easier than ever to structure your ideas and streamline your workflow.

title: Unlocking Noeko: Self-Hosting and Enhanced Capabilities
summary: Prepare for the official launch of Noeko's self-hosting capabilities and premium subscription plans, giving you more control and powerful features tailored to your unique requirements.

title: Stunning New Themes & Visual Upgrades
summary: Get ready for a visual refresh as we enhance our existing themes and introduce a vibrant collection of new styles to personalize your experience.

title: Elevated Time-Based Greetings
summary: We're enhancing your homepage experience with perfectly accurate time-of-day greetings, making every visit feel more personalized and precise.

title: Enhanced Tag Management
summary: Streamline your workflow by efficiently removing multiple items from a tag directly within the tag view, saving you valuable time and clicks.

title: Unlock Diverse Content Sources
summary: Soon, you'll be able to effortlessly integrate and interact with a rich variety of content formats beyond PDFs, including web pages, videos, and text files, all within our unified interface.
